bug_summary: Swapped the MapperFeature consulted when lazily constructing the PropertyBasedCreator for property-based enum creators: the code now passes MapperFeature.ACCEPT_CASE_INSENSITIVE_ENUMS where it previously passed MapperFeature.ACCEPT_CASE_INSENSITIVE_PROPERTIES. This makes creator-property lookup follow the enum-level case-insensitivity setting instead of the properties-level one, so behavior diverges only when the two flags are configured differently and the input's creator property name differs in case from the declared name. Everything else, including all comments and formatting, is unchanged.
